description: Read balances, beneficiaries, global accounts, transfers and exchange rates; validate and manage payouts.

airwallex_new_beneficiary_trigger.description: Runs for each new beneficiary in Airwallex. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, nickname, beneficiary

airwallex_new_global_account_trigger.description: Runs for each new global account in Airwallex. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, account_name, account_number, currency, status

airwallex_new_or_updated_beneficiary_tri.description: Runs for each beneficiary added or changed in Airwallex. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, nickname, beneficiary

airwallex_new_or_updated_global_account_.description: Runs for each global account added or changed in Airwallex. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, account_name, account_number, currency, status

airwallex_new_or_updated_transfer_trigge.description: Runs for each transfer added or changed in Airwallex. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, status, request_id, beneficiary_id, source_currency, transfer_currency, transfer_amount, created_at, updated_at, reference

airwallex_new_transfer_trigger.description: Runs for each new transfer in Airwallex. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, status, request_id, beneficiary_id, source_currency, transfer_currency, transfer_amount, created_at, updated_at, reference
